type: read-only focused triage of current repeated-source editorial holds
scopeNote: The pilot snapshot grouped 21 rows heuristically without a saved member list. Current hold decisions contain 25 reason texts matching word-boundary repeat/repeats; this report covers that safer superset.
algorithm: Exact source inventory sentence/meaning, repeated-source peers, selected/canonical owner meaning and full-source target regex checked; no lexical match alone treated as proof of same sense.
